svg.title: Youth observations and passing habits
svg.desc: Wyscout 2017/18 · Historical observations at the 31 May 2018 cutoff Tiers describe current evidence, not future potential. Eligible ages: 16–21; no 16-year-olds were covered. Pass shares pool located attempts within each position; they do not measure standing positions.
